author: Haruko
name: HaruAdmins
short: Persistent Discord timeouts longer than 28 days.
description: Adds a hybrid timeout command and automatically renews long timeouts in Discord-compliant 28-day segments.
install_msg: HaruAdmins loaded. Use /timeout with a member, duration, and optional reason.
end_user_data_statement: Stores the target Discord user ID, moderator Discord user ID, expiration time, and reason for each bot-managed timeout longer than 28 days.
